items.gist: Knowledge suited to manifestation and yoga leads to absorption in that reality. All states depend on guru initiation, mantra, and scripture, including past, present, and future karma.
For one desiring enjoyment, impure karma must be purified, not auspicious karma. The best teacher performs material initiation with offerings, while knowledge-based initiation purifies through union.

Through the guru's firmly rooted self-knowledge, impure karma is forcibly destroyed and auspicious results follow. By gradation within the path, enjoyment of fruits is completed and future karma is destroyed.

When impure portions are purified, enjoyment does not diminish, and nothing in the path yields suffering. After enjoying all pleasures in maya, one attains dissolution in the partless or whole through the guru's power.
